notes: Version 2.45 records the I-3 correction in Foundation 2.6 and its consumers NIF-Note 1.6, Q6a 2.5, FM-Note 3.3, Q5a 3.3, Q5b 2.3, Q14 3.3, E2 2.3, Gravity 3.6 and SG-Note 2.4; the consumers no longer state that the admissibility axioms force irreducibility or that A3 is a non-factorisability axiom. In Gravity and SG-Note the coherence extensivity hypothesis H-ext stays explicit and distinct from the sector reading. Irreducibility of the admissible fibre follows from A1 and A3 and a representation-theoretic dictionary only under an additional sector reading of A3, not derived, on which a generator-stable decomposition counts as premature selection. The discreteness of quantum transitions is postulated by A4, not derived: on the supplied Heisenberg shell realisation a realised saturation depth is an integer (O22), and the existence of such a depth is not established. The Projective Observability Principle is an adopted principle, not a consequence of A1-A4, and the physical reality of the proto-state and the revelation reading of the projection are interpretive readings. The white-paper entry states that the white paper proposes the substrate chi and the relaxation mechanism and that Foundation derives neither from A1-A4. The HeisenbergStructure entry states that the non-factorisability lemma formalises A3 only under a reading that is not derived. The consumer entries, table rows, graph nodes and bibliography notes are aligned. These corrections close the attributions to Foundation; the existence of a locking depth and the status of O22's own integrality argument remain open.
